section: Iterate — change: pin GitHub Actions and add Dependabot cooldown
title: Pin all GitHub Actions to commit SHAs; 7-day Dependabot cooldown
context: The 2026-10-23 scan flagged 11 mutable action tags and a Dependabot config without cooldown. The project had no recorded posture on action pinning.
decision: Operator decision (2026-10-23): pin every action, GitHub-owned included, to a full commit SHA with a version comment; Dependabot github-actions updates keep pins current. Dependabot waits 7 days before proposing new npm and action versions.
consequences: A retagged or hijacked action release can no longer change CI silently; upstream action fixes now arrive via Dependabot PRs after the cooldown. dependabot.yml also lost an invalid duplicate npm entry and an unsupported auto-merge key.
rationale: Pinning everything clears all scanner findings and closes the retag attack path; Dependabot removes the maintenance cost of stale pins.
rejected: Pinning third-party actions only (Shipwright default): leaves GitHub-owned actions mutable and needs a standing semgrep suppression.
